text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp is here. While other students are training hard to achieve their next goal, Mejiro Ryan reveals that she has to skip the autumn Tenno Sho to recover from her injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ryan will instead spend her time at camp helping Mejiro McQueen train, so that she can carry on her hopes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Ines Fujin reaffirms her own motivation. She knows that plenty of people are pinning their hopes on her, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If Ines is going to learn to love running even more than she already does, we'd better make this a fruitful camp experience!
